{{Short description|Chinese probabilist and statistician}}

'''Qi-Man Shao''' ({{zh|s=邵启满}}; born 1962) is a Chinese probabilist and [[statistician]] mostly known for his contributions to asymptotic theory in probability and statistics. He is currently a Chair Professor of Statistics and Data Science<ref>{{Cite web |title=Faculty Profiles - SUSTech |url=https://faculty.sustech.edu.cn/?field=Department%20of%20Statistics%20and%20Data%20Science&lang=en |access-date=2022-12-16 |website=faculty.sustech.edu.cn}}</ref> at the [[Southern University of Science and Technology]].

== Biography ==
He earned a bachelor's degree in Mathematics and a master's degree in Statistics & Probability from [[Hangzhou University]] (now [[Zhejiang University]]) in 1983 and 1986, respectively. He went to graduate school at the [[University of Science and Technology of China]] and received a Ph.D. degree in Statistics & Probability in 1989. He spent four years as lecturer and then associate professor at [[Hangzhou University]] from 1986 to 1990. In July 1990, he joined [[Carleton University|Carleton University, Canada]] as a visiting research fellow, working with [[Miklós Csörgő]]. From September 1991 to August 1992, he worked as a Taft Postdoctoral Fellow at the [[University of Cincinnati]]. He joined the [[National University of Singapore]] as a lecturer in 1992, and later became a senior lecturer.

He joined the [[University of Oregon]] as an assistant professor in 1996, and was later promoted to associate professor and professor. From 2005 to 2012, he was a professor and Chair Professor at the [[Hong Kong University of Science and Technology]]. In 2012, he moved to the [[Chinese University of Hong Kong]], where he served as Department Chair from 2013 to 2018<ref>{{Cite web |date=2021-05-04 |title=Department History - STA, CUHK |url=https://www.sta.cuhk.edu.hk/about-us/department-history/ |access-date=2022-12-16 |website=www.sta.cuhk.edu.hk |language=en-US}}</ref> and became the Choh-Ming Li Professor of Statistics in 2015.<ref>{{Cite web |title=The Chinese University of Hong Kong Holds 78th Congregation for the Conferment of Degrees {{!}} CUHK Communications and Public Relations Office |url=https://www.cpr.cuhk.edu.hk/en/press/the-chinese-university-of-hong-kong-holds-78th-congregation-for-the-conferment-of-degrees/ |access-date=2022-12-16 |website=The Chinese University of Hong Kong Holds 78th Congregation for the Conferment of Degrees {{!}} CUHK Communications and Public Relations Office |language=en}}</ref> Starting March 2019, he moved to the [[Southern University of Science and Technology]], as a Chair Professor and the Founding Chairman of the Department of Statistics and Data Science.

His research interests include asymptotic theory in [[Probability theory|probability]] and [[Asymptotic theory (statistics)|statistics]], self-normalized limit theory, [[Stein's method|Stein’s method]], and [[High-dimensional statistics|high-dimensional and large-scale statistical analysis]]. He is particularly well-known for his fundamental contributions to self-normalized large and moderate deviation theories, Stein’s method for normal and non-normal approximation, and the development of various probability inequalities for dependent random variables. He authored and co-authored over 180 articles on probability and statistics, and co-authored three well-known books (''Monte Carlo Methods in Bayesian Computation'' (2000),<ref>{{Cite book |url=https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-1-4612-1276-8 |title=Monte Carlo Methods in Bayesian Computation |series=Springer Series in Statistics |year=2000 |language=en |doi=10.1007/978-1-4612-1276-8|isbn=978-1-4612-7074-4 |last1=Chen |first1=Ming-Hui |last2=Shao |first2=Qi-Man |last3=Ibrahim |first3=Joseph G. }}</ref> ''Self-normalized Processes: Limit Theory and Statistical Applications'' (2009),<ref>{{Cite book |url=https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-3-540-85636-8 |title=Self-Normalized Processes |series=Probability and its Applications |year=2009 |language=en |doi=10.1007/978-3-540-85636-8|isbn=978-3-540-85635-1 |last1=Peña |first1=Victor H. |last2=Lai |first2=Tze Leung |last3=Shao |first3=Qi-Man }}</ref> ''and Normal Approximation by Stein’s Method'' (2011)<ref>{{Cite book |url=https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-3-642-15007-4 |title=Normal Approximation by Stein's Method |series=Probability and Its Applications |year=2011 |language=en |doi=10.1007/978-3-642-15007-4|isbn=978-3-642-15006-7 |last1=Chen |first1=Louis H. Y. |last2=Goldstein |first2=Larry |last3=Shao |first3=Qi-Man }}</ref>)''.''

== Honors and awards ==

* Fok Ying Tung Education Foundation Award, 1989
* The State Natural Science Award (the 3rd class), 1997 (Z.Y. Lin, C.R. Lu and Q.M. Shao)
* Elected Fellow, the [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]],<ref>{{Cite web |date=2016-03-03 |title=IMS Awards |url=http://imstat.org/awards/honored_fellows.htm |access-date=2022-12-16 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160303175316/http://imstat.org/awards/honored_fellows.htm |archive-date=2016-03-03 }}</ref> 2001
* [[List of International Congresses of Mathematicians Plenary and Invited Speakers|Invited speaker]] (45min) at the 2010 [[International Congress of Mathematicians]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=International Congress of Mathematicians 2010, Hyderabad » Invited Speakers |url=https://www.mathunion.org/fileadmin/IMU/ICM2010/offline/www.icm2010.in/scientific-program/invited-speakers.html |access-date=2022-12-16 |language=en-US}}</ref>
* IMS Medallion Lecturer, Keynote Speaker at the 2011 [[Joint Statistical Meetings]]<ref>{{Cite web |date=2011-05-01 |title=JSM 2011 Keynote Speakers {{!}} Amstat News |url=https://magazine.amstat.org/blog/2011/05/01/keyspeaker11/ |access-date=2022-12-16 |language=en-US}}</ref>
* Plenary speaker, 36th Conference on Stochastic Processes and Their Applications, 2013<ref>{{Cite web |title=Plenary Speakers {{!}} SPA2013 |url=https://math.colorado.edu/spa2013/?page_id=63 |access-date=2022-12-16 |language=en-US}}</ref>
* Plenary speaker, IMS-China International Conference on Statistics and Probability, 2013
* The State Natural Science Award (the 2nd class), 2015 (Q.-M. Shao and B.-Y. Jing)<ref>{{Cite web |title=2015年度国家自然科学奖获奖项目 - 中华人民共和国科学技术部 |url=https://www.most.gov.cn/ztzl/gjkxjsjldh/jldh2015/jldh15jlgg/201601/t20160106_123343.html |access-date=2022-12-16 |website=www.most.gov.cn}}</ref>

== Professional services ==

* co-Editor, [[The Annals of Applied Probability]] (1/2022 – 12/2024)<ref>{{Cite web |title=Institute of Mathematical Statistics {{!}} Annals of Applied Probability |url=https://imstat.org/journals-and-publications/annals-of-applied-probability/ |access-date=2022-12-16}}</ref>
* [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]] (IMS) Committee on Fellows, Member in 2007–2009 and 2011, Chair in 2009
* IMS Committee on Nominations (2011, 2016, 2017), Institute of Mathematical Statistics<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Institute of Mathematical Statistics {{!}} Past Committee Members |url=https://imstat.org/past-committee-members/ |access-date=2022-12-16}}</ref>
* Council Member, [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]] (2019–2022)<ref>{{Cite web |title=Institute of Mathematical Statistics {{!}} Past Elected Council Members |url=https://imstat.org/past-elected-council-members/ |access-date=2022-12-16}}</ref>
